page.help: Tickets let members ask staff for help in a private channel. They press a button on the ticket panel (a message Mewvo posts) and get their own channel that only they and staff can see. Modmail is the same idea through a private message to Mewvo. You can also set this up with /ticket setup in Discord.

topic.ticketsLine: The button members press to open a ticket, and where tickets go.
topic.modmailLine: Who may not message staff, and answers staff post often.

panel.title: Ticket panel
panel.help: The message with the button members press.
panel.helpNoAdmin: The message with the button members press. To post the panel you need the Administrator permission in this server.
panel.textNote: Saving the panel text below does not change the message already in Discord. Update the panel to show the new text.
panel.none: No ticket panel yet. Fill this in to post one.
panel.postInHelp: Pick a channel every member can see.
panel.submit: Set up and post the panel

settings.title: Ticket settings
settings.help: Categories, the staff role, logs and the panel text.
settings.openCategoryHelp: A category is a folder of channels. New ticket channels are made in it.
settings.staffRoleHelp: Members with this role can see and answer every ticket.
settings.maxPerUserHelp: How many tickets one member can have open at once. From 1 to 10.
settings.dmOnClose: Message the member when their ticket closes
settings.logChannelHelp: Staff get a short line here when a ticket is opened, claimed, closed or deleted.
settings.transcriptChannelHelp: A transcript is a file with every message from a ticket. Mewvo posts it here when the ticket closes.
settings.buttonTextHelp: The words on the button members press to open a ticket.
settings.panelMessageHelp: The text above the button. Tell members what tickets are for.

blocked.title: Modmail blocked members
blocked.help: Blocked members cannot start a modmail chat with staff. A chat that is already open stays until staff close it. You can also do this with /modmail block in Discord.
blocked.heading: Block a member
blocked.reasonHelp: Only staff see it, in the dashboard history.

canned.title: Canned answers
canned.help: Saved answers for questions staff get often. Staff post one in a ticket with /canned send. The built-in answers cannot be deleted, but you can change their text by saving an answer with the same name.
canned.name: Name
canned.nameHelp: Staff type this name to post the answer. Small letters, numbers and - only, like refund-policy.

error.name: Names can only use small letters, numbers and -, up to 32 characters.
error.builtIn: "{name}" is built in and cannot be deleted. To change its text, save an answer with the same name.
error.noSuch: There is no saved answer called "{name}".

action.setUp: Ticket system set up: the panel is posted.
action.panelReposted: The panel was missing: a new one is posted.
action.panelUpdated: The live panel now shows the saved text.
action.alreadyBlocked: That member is already blocked from modmail.
action.blockedOpen: {user} can no longer use modmail. Their open conversation #{channel} stays until you close it.

staffRoleNeedsAdmin: To change the staff role you need the Administrator permission in this server (it opens every ticket to its members). Nothing was changed.
